goal: Clarify addnode RPC documentation so users know connection limits do not restrict onetry attempts
Prevent bitcoin-cli netinfo from showing wrapped counts or dropping the manual peers column past 255 peers
agreement: Initial objection to widening block-relay peer counters was resolved by dropping that change (jonatack)
Suggestion to clarify separate limits for add and onetry in RPC help was adopted (jonatack)

categories.name: rpc
why: P4 because it only addresses a minor cosmetic display bug and documentation clarity
Manual peer counts exceeding 255 wrap and display wrong numbers or make the netinfo column vanish
Accumulating over 255 manual peers via onetry connections is rare in practice
